column5: Pointer to the entrant book, 6-byte entries (+0 club or nation, +4 class, +5 status); the World Cup keeps its qualified nations here (inherited from Comp, as cup ENTRANT_BOOK)
Number of entries used in ENTRANT_BOOK (inherited from Comp)
Capacity of ENTRANT_BOOK; add_qualified_team only adds while ENTRANT_COUNT is below it (inherited from Comp)
Number of club slots in SELECTED_CLUBS filled by select_section_clubs (compared up to 0x38) [inference]
Game year of the last update_for_new_season; the club table and the Libertadores places are rebuilt only when the year changes
Club id of the Copa dos Campeoes winner (its Libertadores place from 2003 on), set by set_bra_champ_cup_winner
Pointer to the list of up to 30 club ids volunteering for the Intertoto (0x78 bytes; count at +0x43f), freed after the places are given
50 records of 12 bytes (cup, winner, runner-up) of national cup finals, written by register_semi_final_losers_for_uefa and read when giving UEFA places
Club pointer of the season's champion (team table status 1) in a competition history row (row +4 competition, +8 year)
Club pointer of the runner-up (team table status 2)
Club pointer of the third-placed team (team table status 3)
Host of the competition, fourth value of season_honours [inference]
Pointer to the drawn list of qualified club pointers that fills the first group tables; freed and zeroed once the groups are built
Number of clubs in DRAWN_CLUBS [inference]
Pointer to the drawn list of invited club pointers that fills the first group tables; freed and zeroed once the groups are built
Number of clubs in DRAWN_CLUBS [inference]
Pointer to the shuffled list of invited club pointers (Mexico, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia, MLS) that fills the group tables
Number of clubs in DRAWN_CLUBS (16 once selected)
Pointer to the 8 selected club pointers (group A slots 0..3, group B 4..7); freed and zeroed once the groups are built
Number of clubs in DRAWN_CLUBS, zeroed with the list [inference]
Pointer to the nations drawn from 4 pots into 4 groups of 4; freed and zeroed once the group stages are built
Number of entries in DRAWN_CLUBS, zeroed with the list
Pointer to the list of team pointers (the continent's nations and the guests) built by set_up_team_list
Number of teams in DRAWN_CLUBS (12 when full)
Group format (1 or 2): decides whether group g has 6 or 5 teams (get_group_team_count)
Pointer to one absence flag byte per staff id (bit 1 absent without leave, bit 2 missed training; flipped by the mark routines) [inference]
Start date of a match-watching scout assignment (TCMDate: day +0x1a5, year +0x1a7); moved to tomorrow by scout_match; end date at +0x1ad
Year half of SCOUTING_START_DATE
Pointer to the 14-byte ruling body entries (ruling_body_entry)
Allocated entries in ENTRIES (count + 100 after compact_entries)
Number of entries used in ENTRIES
Tactical grid cell codes of the 11 formation slots (words; a second set follows at +0x14e)
Tactics flag dword (0x1000 marking by ball side, 0x4000, 0x400...), changed by set_formation_flag
Marking type byte of each of the 11 slots (4 and 8 become 2 in clear_assigned)
Person record index designated for each of the 11 positions (-1 none)
Position lookup tables built by build_position_lookup (up to FORMATION_MASK)
OR of the position bits of the 11 slots (formation_mask)
Changed flag of the formation, cleared by set_square and written with the marking and formation flags
